documents.title: QBR call - Feb
documents.body: Priya Raman (Head of Inspections): we are flying two docks daily and want a third site by Q3.

documents.title: P1 - dock offline
documents.body: Dock 2 offline for 11 days. Customer escalated to their VP. Second escalation logged 2026-03-09.

documents.title: Escalation call - Mar
documents.body: Priya Raman: we have paused the third-site expansion until reliability is proven.
